2075. Shortest Distance Between Two Vertices

60

Medium

Question

There are N cities connected by directed roads. Each road has a non-negative travel cost.

Given a source city and a destination city, find the minimum cost required to travel from the source to the destination.

If the destination cannot be reached, print -1.

Input Format
First line: N M
Next M lines: u v cost
Last line: source destination
Output Format

Print the minimum travel cost.
